name: 01_open_method
task: In 1C Configurator, in the separate window on the right that shows the tree of the configuration extension 'api', find the HTTP service 'api_http' and its URL template 'demo_status', and open the HTTP method of that template.
rules: Work ONLY in the right window with the 'api' tree. Do not create, delete, rename or save anything. Do not press Ctrl+S. Do not use the search boxes.

subgoals.goal: Expand the URL template node 'demo_status' in the right window (click the small plus sign to the left of the demo_status icon) so that its child node (an HTTP method) becomes visible under it. If demo_status is not visible, scroll the right window.
subgoals.check: In the right window, directly under the node 'demo_status' there is at least one indented child node (an HTTP method, for example named GET or similar).

subgoals.goal: Open the HTTP method that is the child of 'demo_status': double-click that child node.
subgoals.check: A properties window or editor for an HTTP method is now open on the screen (for example a window with 'Свойства' or fields like 'HTTP-метод', 'Обработчик').
